integrity: All finite claims have a deterministic standalone field-arithmetic checker and an explicit 14-line/56-point incidence certificate. Algebraic smoothness and optimality also receive a mathematical proof. No independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field result for one explicit canonical genus-three quartic; the complete 651-line spectrum is established by exact enumeration, not a general formula; closest 2026 maximal-curve classification was available only in abstract.
title: Exact line-section spectrum and a perfect line cover of a maximal plane quartic
